answer.explanation: The visible events show no errors, timeouts, throttles or permission failures. Every invocation has an END and a REPORT line, and durations stay well below any plausible timeout. The only Init Duration (544 ms on the Thumbnailer, billed 888 ms) is a single expected cold start, and its billed time reflects the normal init-phase billing. Memory use is well below allocation (Thumbnailer 110 of 1024 MB, Compression about 102 of 1024 MB), which is a cost-efficiency observation rather than a configuration fault. The log is truncated after about 4,268 further events, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
